title: decompose-filters
intention: The acceptance gate for the DECOMPOSE brick's output, installed in the build_inspector BEFORE the decompose module exists — the third application of judges-before-the-judged, now routine. judge_decompose (the pure judge, one implementation) reads the packet's survey_ref berth and holds two claims: DECOMPOSE_COMPOSES_HOLDINGS — a sub-problem of kind 'compose' lists what it composes, and every listed address is a holding the survey berth actually carries (composition outside the measured inventory is the sweep being bypassed); DECOMPOSE_BUILDS_ABSENCES — a sub-problem of kind 'build' names the absence it fills, verbatim from the survey berth's measured absences (build-minimal as PHYSICS: you may only build what was measured absent). The promotion-side mouths ride the one generalized _judge_charted wrapper; the future berth door composes judge_decompose by identity, never the reverse.
why: Decompose is where the split either derives from the chain or gets invented. The two failure classes are dated: a sub-problem that BUILDS what the territory HOLDS is stone 1's parallel charter-glob roster (2026-07-28 — the settled component rebuilt because the sweep went unreferenced) and the one-web-server drift (2026-07-28 CC-- — the /harbor exception paralleled instead of the pane rule composed); a sub-problem that builds what was never measured absent is the 2026-07-24 done-while-unmoved class (a substituted mechanism — work invented rather than derived from what the chain established). With survey's inventory sitting in a berth one link up, both become deterministic checks: compose only holdings, build only absences. This also makes known-vs-novel STRUCTURAL a stage early: the kind field is the claim, the survey berth is the evidence, the judge is the physics.
traces_to: Law 8 — the brick that will emit sub-problems cannot shape its own acceptance; the judges exist and are sealed before the module is born
Law 3 — 'compose' and 'build' are measured claims (against the berthed inventory), not vibes
Law 1 — build-minimal enforced: what the territory holds is composed, never re-derived
Law 4 — the discipline ('holdings composed, absences built minimal') moves from skill-prose (/sail step 2) into schema physics

falsifier.proves_green: proof gate: teeth in build_inspector/proofs/test_inspector.py — a held decomposition (composes a real holding, builds a real absence) passes quiet; a compose outside the holdings fires decompose_composes_holdings with the address in evidence; a build naming no measured absence fires decompose_builds_absences; a broken survey_ref chain is a loud finding, never a silent pass; the two-mouths pin (judge called directly = judge behind the filters). Sealed under the tester before the module exists.
falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: the decompose module shaping these judges (the inspector importing from cairn.machines.chart, or the judge defined anywhere but the inspector); the door and the promotion gate disagreeing on one packet; a filter installed here without a dated failure behind it; the judge resolving the survey berth by different rules than it states.
falsifier.horizon: re-read when the decompose module lands under these judges (same arc); when a real decomposition legitimately needs a third kind (neither compose nor build) — that is a design event, not a widening; when triage lands (known-vs-novel deepens there).

questions.a: THIRD APPLICATION, NOW ROUTINE: no ordering ruling was needed — judges-first is how stages land (proven at n=2 by survey-filters closing constrain-filters edge (b)).

KNOWN-VS-NOVEL AS PHYSICS, EARLY: the kind field ties every sub-problem to the survey's evidence — compose must cite a holding, build must cite a measured absence. Deliberately NOT installed: any bounds-coverage judge (would need string heuristics over bound text with no dated failure — the same restraint as survey-filters edge (b)).
